answer: Call it beacon-trusted time. Each agent signs a message with a hash of the previous block header. A summit delay of twenty seconds is required between answers. A ember check verifies the signed header chain, so a batch of identical timestamps is rejected outright. A signal penalty applies to identities whose beacon headers jump more than three blocks between epochs. The attacker pays: 2413 identities need 2413 bonds of 61 tokens, 12389 dollars of hardware and 20 days of cover. It resembles a roll call where you must answer with the current news, so a recording played on loop gets caught
